content.user_title: Generate Cinematic Videos with Seedance 2.0 Pro
content.value_statement: Short video production requires consistent reference media, camera direction, and audio settings. This skill guides Seedance 2.0 Pro requests through RunComfy with documented parameters and practical examples.
actual_capabilities: Provides RunComfy CLI examples for text-only and reference-guided Seedance 2.0 Pro video requests.
Documents inputs for up to nine images, three videos, and three audio references.
Guides duration, aspect ratio, resolution, audio generation, and seed selection.
Separates stable visual identity references from action, lighting, and camera instructions.
Explains model selection alternatives for motion editing, audio-driven lip sync, and faster iteration.
Documents authentication setup, generated-output downloads, and common CLI exit codes.
limitations: Requires an external RunComfy CLI, account, and network access; the CLI implementation is not included or verified here.
The documented endpoint generates whole-second clips from 4 to 15 seconds at 480p or 720p.
Video and audio references must last 2 to 15 seconds; audio files must remain below 15 MB.
Lip-sync quality is not guaranteed, and character references do not support explicit at-sign binding.

use_cases.title: Plan Short Spokesperson Ads
use_cases.description: Prepare a vertical dialogue clip with a permitted character image, camera movement, and voice direction.

use_cases.title: Preview Cinematic Shots
use_cases.description: Combine scene references and camera instructions to prepare short film previsualization requests.

use_cases.title: Compare Creative Variants
use_cases.description: Keep reference media and seed settings fixed while varying dialogue, lighting, or shot direction.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Draft a Text-Only Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a five-second Seedance 2.0 Pro cafe scene with a slow push-in, warm light, and gentle ambience. Show the plan before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with the documented text-only defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Add a Character Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved image URL to prepare an eight-second vertical spokesperson clip. Request friendly delivery and a medium close-up. Ask for missing inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preserve visual identity with a reference image.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Combine Reference Types
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a ten-second Seedance request using my approved image, video, and audio URLs. Check media limits and align camera direction with the references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate multiple reference types within documented limits.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Plan Controlled Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan three Seedance variants with fixed references, seed, duration, and resolution. Change only camera movement. Confirm the output directory and request approval before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare camera choices while controlling other parameters.

output_examples.input: Prepare a simple five-second cafe video with audio.
output: Illustrative request plan: Seedance 2.0 Pro, five seconds, 720p, synchronized audio enabled.
Scene direction: medium close-up, slow push-in, warm window light, and gentle cafe ambience.
Submission status: not submitted; confirm the output directory and RunComfy authentication first.

output_examples.input: Plan an eight-second vertical spokesperson clip using my approved character image.
output: Illustrative request plan: eight seconds, 9:16 aspect ratio, and the supplied character image as a visual reference.
Performance direction: friendly conversational delivery, medium close-up, and a slow camera push-in.
Expected boundary: lip-sync quality may vary; inspect the generated result before publication.

output_examples.input: Can this endpoint produce a continuous thirty-second video at 1080p?
output_examples.output: The documented endpoint supports 4 to 15 seconds and at most 720p. Plan multiple clips or select another endpoint for higher requirements.

best_practices: Use permitted reference media and confirm approval before sending sensitive content to RunComfy.
Keep identity in image references and describe action, camera movement, lighting, and voice tone in the prompt.
Validate media limits and output settings before submission; inspect generated visuals and audio afterward.
anti_patterns: Requesting clips longer than 15 seconds or resolutions above the documented 720p ceiling.
Combining conflicting visual styles or contradictory camera and lighting instructions.
Replacing reference images with detailed verbal identity descriptions when consistency matters.

faq.question: Does this skill include the video model?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions for accessing Seedance 2.0 Pro through the external RunComfy CLI and hosted API.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with a RunComfy account. Browser login and an environment-token option are documented.

faq.question: What durations and resolutions are documented?
faq.answer: Clips use whole-second durations from 4 to 15 seconds. Resolution options are 480p and 720p, with 720p as the default.

faq.question: Which reference media can I provide?
faq.answer: The documented schema accepts up to nine images, three videos, and three audio references. Video and audio duration limits also apply.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accurate lip sync?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes synchronized audio generation, but lip-sync quality depends on prompt clarity and generation results.

faq.question: Where do prompts and references go?
faq.answer: The guide sends prompts and reference URLs to RunComfy over HTTPS. It states that reference media are fetched by RunComfy servers.
